items.evidence: Log lines 2-3: P20 aspirates 2 uL from plasmid_plate A1 and dispenses into tubes_1_5ml_1 A1.
protocol.comment 'Heat shock cells_rack 42°C 45 s, then transfer immediately to ice 2 min' is placed after DNA addition and before SOC.
Log lines 12-13: P300 moves 250 uL SOC into tube A1 after the heat shock comment; the 37°C 60 min 250 rpm incubation comment follows.
The P20 tip is dropped (line 10) before a new P300 tip is picked up (line 11) and dropped (line 14); no stock contamination.
The agent added p20.mix(3, 10) in the competent cells (log lines 4-9), which the task never asked for and which can reduce transformation efficiency.

judge.summary: The protocol performs the DNA addition, heat shock and ice comment, SOC addition and incubation comment in the right order, with fresh tips that are dropped. It loses fidelity credit for an unrequested 3x pipette mix of the competent cells after DNA addition.
